reviewScope: Local source, offline browser actions, detached output, and scoped independent persistence review.
implementationNotes: The existing map caption carries the short marking on one line. At narrow widths the service count is available in Reading the map.
A custom marking's display grouping can be set before assignment. After assignment, rename and description edits preserve the grouping of all linked networks.
Map marking filters store stable identities. Renaming an asset does not copy its text into saved viewpoints.
Network descriptors remain read-only in owner review. Existing CSV imports continue using the compatibility grouping.
